summary.method: Deduplicated by server world ID. Completed saved summaries or terminal trace scores only; daily scores excluded. Previously audited completed runs retained when raw files were archived. Official ranking and live test-final worlds excluded. A timed practice rehearsal is a practice world; its restarts count once. Source reads bounded by each file size at inventory. Repeated seeds are correlated. Includes the host-mounted Alpha/Epsilon/models archives and worktree run folders; resolved file paths and world IDs prevent double counting symlink aliases. Frozen model controls remain in their own model family; Epsilon variants are combined.
